description: The most relevant number of the problem "market power" of the start page ranking and the potential solution, taken from the two worked examples of the concept paper section 7: a search engine operator with a 91 percent market share in Switzerland would pay about 910 million USD more tax per year under a market share based supplementary tax, while UBS with a 22 percent mortgage market share would move from 11.9 to 13.4 percent. Below a 30 percent market share the ordinary tax legislation applies again.

words.name: power
words.description: Power is the amount of energy transferred or converted per unit time; the SI unit is the watt.

words.name: tax
words.description: compulsory financial charge to public authority

triples.name: market power
triples.description: the ability of a market dominant company to prevent competition, dictate prices and shift profits to low tax jurisdictions (concept paper section 7)

triples.name: market share tax
triples.description: supplementary taxation of corporate profits linked to the market share in the smallest relevant market segment and levied where the economic use occurs (concept paper section 7)

triples.name: market share threshold
triples.description: the market share below which the ordinary tax legislation applies again, so that the rule tends to keep at least three competitors in every market segment

sources.name: MoneyPark (2025) Swiss mortgage market study
sources.description: MoneyPark (2025): Der Schweizer Hypothekarmarkt 2024 - Hypothekarmarktstudie. MoneyPark AG. Source of the 22 percent mortgage market share of UBS used in the worked example of the concept paper section 7.
